title: Faisal Town Phase 2 Overseas Enclave – Map, Plots & Prices
description: Explore Faisal Town Phase 2 Overseas Enclave with map guidance, plot sizes, prices, payment checks, current availability and overseas buyer verification.
intro:
Faisal Town Phase 2 Overseas Enclave is a dedicated residential enclave within FT-II, with current market inventory ranging from smaller residential plots to larger options. Buyers commonly search for its map location, plot sizes, prices, payment status, development progress and current resale availability.

If you are buying from abroad, match the exact enclave or sub-area reference, plot number, payment record and map position before sending any token or purchase payment.
body:
## Faisal Town Phase 2 Overseas Enclave overview

Overseas Enclave is a dedicated residential area within Faisal Town Phase 2.

It is primarily marketed toward overseas Pakistanis, although the actual purchase decision should still be based on the individual property's location, documentation, payment status and current development rather than the enclave name alone.

Current property listings show active resale inventory within the Overseas Enclave, including numbered plots and references to different enclave sub-areas.

Buyers may therefore encounter terms such as Overseas Enclave 4, Overseas Enclave 5 or Overseas Enclave 6 in market listings.

Always confirm which exact enclave or sub-area applies to the property you are considering.

## Overseas Enclave location and map

Use the current Faisal Town Phase 2 master plan together with the relevant Overseas Enclave plan to identify the property.

Do not rely only on a cropped map image or a dealer's pin.

For the exact property, confirm:

- Overseas Enclave sub-area
- plot number
- street or road
- plot dimensions
- nearby boulevard or access
- corner or non-corner position
- development around the plot
- current access to the site

A map is useful for initial orientation, but the individual property should be matched with the paperwork and, where possible, physically inspected.

For an overseas buyer who cannot visit personally, request a fresh live video walkthrough showing the approach road, plot number or location reference, surrounding development and nearby landmarks.

## Overseas Enclave plot sizes

Current project-focused material and market listings show several residential plot sizes within the Overseas Enclave.

Commonly marketed sizes include approximately:

- 5 or 5.56 marla
- 8 marla
- 10 or 10.89 marla
- 14 or 14.22 marla
- 1 kanal
- 2 kanal

Current resale listings also show examples such as 25 x 50 and 30 x 60 plots.

Do not rely only on the rounded marla description.

Before buying, verify the precise dimensions and area from the relevant allotment, transfer or plot documentation.

This is particularly important when comparing two properties that may both be marketed simply as 5 marla or 8 marla.

## Overseas Enclave plots for sale

The Overseas Enclave has an active resale market.

Current listings include numbered residential plots and inventory described as fully paid, NDC-ready or having different payment and dues positions.

That means two listings with the same plot size may not represent the same financial position.

Before comparing asking prices, identify whether the seller is offering:

- a numbered residential plot
- a file or allocation
- fully paid inventory
- partially paid inventory
- NDC-ready inventory
- inventory with development or possession charges already paid
- inventory with outstanding dues

The asking price should only be compared after these differences are understood.

## Overseas Enclave prices

There is no single reliable price for every Overseas Enclave property.

Current asking prices vary because of:

- plot size
- exact enclave or sub-area
- plot number
- road width
- corner or main-road position
- development status
- payment completion
- outstanding dues
- possession or handover status
- seller urgency
- prevailing resale demand

For example, current listings show different asking prices even for broadly similar 8-marla plots depending on their enclave reference, dues position and location.

For this reason, use live comparable listings rather than an old average price.

Compare at least several properties with the same approximate size and similar payment status before judging whether a particular asking price is reasonable.

## Overseas Enclave payment plan

Payment terms should be checked against the exact inventory being offered.

Fresh booking, installment inventory and resale property may all have different payment structures.

Current market material advertises installment-based options for Overseas Enclave inventory, but buyers should verify the current schedule before booking because developer rates and installment structures can change.

Before making payment, request a written breakdown showing:

- total agreed price
- amount already paid
- remaining balance
- installment schedule
- development charges
- possession charges, if applicable
- transfer charges
- location premium
- taxes
- other transaction costs

Do not treat an old payment plan image as proof of the current payable amount.

## Overseas Enclave development status

Development should be checked at the exact plot location.

Current resale listings describe development as active in parts of the Overseas Enclave, but individual sub-areas may differ.

During a site visit or live video inspection, look for:

- road formation or carpeting
- plot demarcation
- sewerage or drainage work
- electricity infrastructure
- access roads
- surrounding construction
- machinery or active development
- completed or occupied properties
- current site accessibility

Do not assume the entire Overseas Enclave has identical development or possession status.

If a seller claims that a plot is developed, ready for possession or carries paid development charges, ask for documentation supporting that claim.

## Overseas Enclave sub-area references

Market listings sometimes use numbered Overseas Enclave references such as Overseas Enclave 4, 5 or 6.

These references are useful for narrowing the property location, but they should not replace the actual plot number and map position.

If a listing says only “Overseas Enclave,” ask the seller to provide:

- exact enclave or sub-area
- plot number
- street or road
- map reference
- payment status
- current dues
- development status

For SEO and usability, this website keeps one main Overseas Enclave page rather than creating thin separate pages for every numbered sub-area without enough verified information.

## Buying from overseas

An overseas purchase requires more verification because the buyer may not be able to inspect the property personally.

Before paying a token, request:

- current plot documents
- seller or allottee identification
- payment history
- outstanding dues statement
- current map
- exact Google Maps or site pin
- live video walkthrough
- plot or street reference
- transfer requirements
- payment instructions in writing

If possible, nominate a trusted family member or representative to inspect the site before making a significant payment.

A recorded video can be useful, but a live call is better because you can ask the person on site to show the surrounding road, adjacent plots and location markers in real time.

## Power of attorney and representative purchases

If a relative, attorney or representative will complete part of the transaction for an overseas buyer, confirm what documentation is required before sending funds.

Depending on the transaction, this may involve identity verification, authority documents, transfer forms or a power of attorney.

Do not rely on an agent's verbal description of the process.

Ask for the current documentation requirements relevant to the exact transaction and have significant legal documents reviewed appropriately before execution.

## Payment safety for overseas buyers

Payment verification is especially important when the buyer is outside Pakistan.

Before transferring money, confirm:

- the legal recipient
- purpose of payment
- bank account details
- property or file reference
- payment amount
- official receipt process
- whether the amount is refundable
- whether the payment is a token, installment or final settlement

Avoid transferring substantial funds to an unrelated personal account without clear written documentation.

Keep copies of transfer receipts, acknowledgements and payment schedules.

## What overseas buyers should verify

Before finalizing an Overseas Enclave property, confirm:

- exact enclave or sub-area
- plot number
- dimensions
- map position
- ownership or allocation documents
- payment history
- outstanding dues
- development charges
- transfer status
- possession status
- access to the site
- location premium
- current development
- total acquisition cost

If a listing promises a special overseas discount, guaranteed profit or priority possession, request current written documentation before relying on that claim.

## Is Overseas Enclave good for investment?

Overseas Enclave can be considered as part of a broader Faisal Town Phase 2 comparison, but the investment value depends on the individual property and the price you pay.

Evaluate:

- exact enclave location
- purchase price
- dues status
- development progress
- resale demand
- plot size
- nearby access
- competing listings
- holding period
- total acquisition cost

A lower-priced property is not necessarily the better investment if it has weaker location, unclear documentation or substantial unpaid charges.

Similarly, a premium-labelled Overseas Enclave plot should not automatically be considered superior simply because of its branding.

## Overseas Enclave vs other Phase 2 sectors

Overseas Enclave should be compared with the other Faisal Town Phase 2 options relevant to your budget.

Depending on your objective, you may also compare:

- Sector O / Model Block
- Sector P
- Sector R
- Sector T
- other active Phase 2 sectors

An overseas buyer focused on long-term residential use may prioritize plot size, access and development.

An investor may place more weight on entry price, resale demand, payment status and expected development timeline.

Compare the actual properties rather than selecting a sector or enclave only from its name.

## Overseas Enclave site-visit checklist

If you or a representative can visit the project, take the plot reference and map with you.

Check:

- exact plot location
- plot number
- road width
- site level
- access road
- surrounding development
- nearby construction
- corner or main-road position
- drainage condition
- nearby commercial or community areas
- distance from major project access

Take current photographs and video so the physical site can later be compared with the paperwork.

If the property cannot be clearly identified on the ground, resolve the discrepancy before making payment.

faqsText:
Is Overseas Enclave part of Faisal Town Phase 2? | Yes. The Overseas Enclave covered on this page is part of Faisal Town Phase 2.

Who is Faisal Town Phase 2 Overseas Enclave intended for? | It is primarily marketed toward overseas Pakistanis, although buyers should still verify the exact property's eligibility, documents and current payment terms.

What plot sizes are available in Overseas Enclave? | Current project-focused material markets sizes from approximately 5 or 5.56 marla through 8, 10 or 10.89, 14 or 14.22 marla and larger 1- and 2-kanal options. Exact dimensions should be checked from the property documents.

Are Overseas Enclave plots available for sale? | Yes. Current property portals show active resale inventory, including numbered residential plots in different Overseas Enclave sub-areas.

What do Overseas Enclave 4, 5 or 6 mean? | Current market listings sometimes use numbered enclave references. Confirm the exact sub-area, plot number and map position before relying on the listing name.

Are Overseas Enclave prices fixed? | No. Asking prices vary according to plot size, exact location, payment status, outstanding dues, development, road position and current market demand.

Can I buy an Overseas Enclave plot while living abroad? | Remote buying is possible in practice, but buyers should verify documents, payment instructions, plot location and transfer requirements and arrange a trusted site inspection or live video verification where possible.

Should I use a power of attorney when buying from overseas? | A representative or power of attorney may be relevant in some transactions. Confirm the current documentation requirements for your specific transfer before executing legal documents.

Is Overseas Enclave good for investment? | It may suit some investors, but the individual property's price, location, development, dues, documentation and resale demand should be evaluated before purchasing.

Should I physically inspect the plot? | Yes. A site visit by you or a trusted representative is strongly recommended before making a substantial payment.
